A small collection of books I've been reading, revisiting, or thinking about lately. Some science, literature, philosophy, and some music scores. 

```{=html}
<div class="bookshelf">

  <div class="fu-decoration" aria-label="Upside-down Chinese fu character for good fortune">
    <span>福</span>
  </div>

  <div class="books">
  <button class="book book-sage"
    data-title="The Story of Birds"
    data-author="Stephen Brusatte"
    data-description="Changed how I see birds...  how they function to where they came from, to what they are.">
    <span>The Story of Birds</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-clay"
    data-title="The Three-Body Problem"
    data-author="Liu Cixin"
    data-description="Mind-blowing scientific ideas woven into a gripping story that crosses cultures and history, all while asking questions about humanity's fate.">
    <span>The Three-Body Problem</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-sand"
    data-title="Taiwan Travelogue"
    data-author="Yáng Shuāng-zǐ"
    data-description="Mouth watering descriptions of food from home"
    <span>Taiwan Travelogue</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-blue"
    data-title="The Dispossessed"
    data-author="Ursula K. Le Guin">
    <span>The Dispossessed</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-green"
    data-title="Advanced R, 2e"
    data-author="Hadley Wickham">
    <span>Advanced R, 2e</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-burgundy"
    data-title="Gödel, Escher, Bach"
    data-author="Douglas Hofstadter"
    data-description="I'll probably never finish this tome. It sits on my shelf and stares at me every day.">
    <span>Gödel, Escher, Bach</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-ochre"
    data-title="Dune"
    data-author="Frank Herbert">
    <span>Dune</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-navy"
    data-title="Moby-Dick"
    data-author="Herman Melville">
    <span>Moby-Dick</span>
  </button>

  <button class="book book-ivory"
    data-title="The Well-Tempered Clavier"
    data-author="Johann Sebastian Bach">
    <span>The Well-Tempered Clavier</span>
   </button>
  </div>

  <div class="wood-shelf"></div>

  <div class="book-details" aria-live="polite">
  <strong id="selected-book-title">Select a book</strong>
  <p id="selected-book-author"></p>
  <p id="selected-book-description"></p>
</div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.bookshelf .book').forEach(book => {
  book.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.getElementById('selected-book-title').textContent =
      book.dataset.title;
    document.getElementById('selected-book-author').textContent =
      book.dataset.author;
    document.getElementById('selected-book-description').textContent =
      book.dataset.description || '';

    document.querySelectorAll('.bookshelf .book').forEach(b =>
      b.classList.remove('selected')
    );
    book.classList.add('selected');
  });
});
</script>
```
